## Reusable rules

1. **Use an action separator for toolbox action routes** For this action on the toolbox route, feedback specified the `:` action separator and the final patch uses `:invoke_mcp`; do not generalize the exact action name beyond this operation. *Scope:* Foundry toolbox action-route naming *Explicit reviewer guidance.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/45805#discussion_r3917771329, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/45805#discussion_r3918384385, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/45805#discussion_r3927412313, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/e1992312aa4724852fe7ebf711de05b1da0ce35a/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/toolboxes/routes.tsp

2. **Distinguish JSON request shape from response formats** The review settled on `Record<unknown>` for the request, while noting that a response may be `text/event-stream`; the frozen patch retains `unknown` for the response. Choose each schema based on supported formats rather than mirroring request and response types. *Scope:* Generic MCP invocation request and response bodies *Explicit reviewer guidance.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/45805#discussion_r3909334194, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/45805#discussion_r3917187153, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/45805#discussion_r3917537931, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/45805#discussion_r3917685366, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/e1992312aa4724852fe7ebf711de05b1da0ce35a/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/toolboxes/routes.tsp

3. **Keep SDK-specific preservation decorators out of REST routes** Feedback questioned decorators used to preserve a named model for handwritten SDK code and directed moving them to the appropriate `client.tsp` file(s), rather than putting SDK-specific customization in the REST API TypeSpec. *Scope:* SDK model-preservation decorators in TypeSpec projects *Explicit reviewer guidance.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/45805#discussion_r3906979983, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/45805#discussion_r3909242627, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/45805#discussion_r3909279193
